components.title: Fade-in text
components.ownerDescription: Text that fades in with a soft blur when the page loads.

components.title: Scale in
components.ownerDescription: Text or content that grows into place from a slightly smaller size.
components.snippet:
---
import ScaleIn from "@astroanimate/core/ScaleIn";
---
<ScaleIn as="h2">Grows into place</ScaleIn>

components.title: Reveal image
components.ownerDescription: A headline where the letters reveal a background image as you scroll past.
components.snippet:
---
import RevealImage from "@astroanimate/core/RevealImage";
---
<RevealImage text="REVEAL" image1="/images/before.jpg" image2="/images/after.jpg" />

components.title: Highlight text
components.ownerDescription: A highlighter-style underline or background sweep behind a phrase.

components.title: Typewriter text
components.ownerDescription: A line of text that types itself out, one character at a time.

keyProps.texts: array of strings to cycle through (required)

components.title: Animated card
components.ownerDescription: A card that lifts, scales, or shines on hover.

props.title: Feature
props.description: A short description of the feature.

components.snippet:
---
import AnimatedCard from "@astroanimate/core/AnimatedCard";
---
<AnimatedCard title="Feature" description="A short description of the feature." />

components.title: Card stack
components.ownerDescription: A stack of testimonial or feature cards, one in front of the other.

keyProps.enhance: keep false — CSS-only mode (site CSP blocks enhance=true)

components.title: Article card
components.ownerDescription: A blog-post or article preview card with a title, summary, and link.

props.title: Article title
props.description: A short summary of the article.

components.snippet:
---
import ArticleCard from "@astroanimate/core/ArticleCard";
---
<ArticleCard title="Article title" description="A short summary of the article." href="/blog/post" />

components.title: Animated button
components.ownerDescription: A button with a shimmer, fill, or border sweep on hover.

keyProps.href: renders as a link when set

components.title: Fill hover button
components.ownerDescription: A button whose background fills in from one edge on hover.

components.title: Arrow CTA button
components.ownerDescription: A call-to-action link whose arrow slides forward on hover.
components.snippet:
---
import ArrowCTAButton from "@astroanimate/core/ArrowCTAButton";
---
<ArrowCTAButton label="Learn more" href="/about" as="a" />

components.title: Sliding overlay button
components.ownerDescription: A button with a color overlay that slides in on hover.

components.title: Grid dots background
components.ownerDescription: A subtle dot-grid or line-grid backdrop for a section.

components.title: Infinite marquee
components.ownerDescription: A row of logos, text, or cards that scrolls continuously and loops.
components.snippet: --- import InfiniteMarquee from "@astroanimate/core/InfiniteMarquee"; --- Trusted by teams everywhere

components.title: Loader
components.ownerDescription: A spinning, dotted, or pulsing loading indicator.

components.title: Progress bar
components.ownerDescription: A labeled progress bar that fills to a given value.
components.snippet:
---
import ProgressBar from "@astroanimate/core/ProgressBar";
---
<ProgressBar value={60} label="Upload progress" />
